Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that “Battle Beyond the Sun (1959), a Soviet feature” was the shared source, confusing the U.S. re-edit (1962) with the original Soviet film. This misidentification occurred before verifying evidence and conflated titles/years; the correct 1959 Soviet feature is Nebo Zovyot (The Heavens Call).
